author: coach (Claude)
status_note: Values were read from the 2011 Compendium of Physical Activities PDF (Ainsworth et al.). Before shipping, the implementer must re-open the PDF at the source URL, confirm every code/MET pair below against the table rows, and record the result in docs/STATE.md. Any row that does not match must be corrected from the PDF, not from this file. Also check whether the chosen rows are the 'estimated' (italic) kind in the Compendium; if a row is italic, mark it estimated and keep the UI caveat.

source.citation: Ainsworth BE, Haskell WL, Herrmann SD, et al. 2011 Compendium of Physical Activities: a second update of codes and MET values. Med Sci Sports Exerc. 2011;43(8):1575-1581.
source.pdf_url: https://sites.google.com/site/compendiumofphysicalactivities/ (official site) ; copy used for reading: fitmum.ku.dk Compendium PDF
source.licence_note: MET values are published numbers; cite the source in the UI. No text of the Compendium is copied.

formulas.live_counter: kcal_so_far = kcal_per_min * (elapsed_ms_from_timestamps / 60000). Use timestamps (Date.now / performance.now deltas), never a setInterval tick counter.
formulas.rounding: Display whole kcal. Keep full precision internally.
formulas.gross_vs_net: Gross includes the resting energy the body spends anyway. Net is the extra energy caused by the exercise. Show gross as 'الإجمالي' and net as 'الزيادة بسبب التمرين'. Any energy-balance integration (daily target, EAT) must use NET to avoid double counting resting energy. Report in docs/STATE.md how the existing engine consumes cardio kcal; do not change the engine formulas (R4).
formulas.fat_grams: NOT computed. The share of fat burned in a session depends on intensity, fitness and diet and cannot be derived honestly from MET alone. The UI shows kcal only. Do not convert kcal to grams of fat anywhere.
formulas.weight_source: Use the weight logged in the user's profile. If missing, ask for it before showing an estimate.

ui_caveat_ar: ده تقدير تقريبي بيعتمد على جدول MET العلمي. الرقم الحقيقي بيختلف من شخص لشخص حسب الوزن واللياقة وطريقة الأداء.

required_tests: Each worked example above must be reproduced by the production function to within 0.01 kcal.
Every activity has exactly three levels and every level has a code, a MET and an Arabic hint.

kcal is monotonic in weight, in minutes and in level (light < moderate < high) for all activities except where the table itself is non-monotonic; if the table is non-monotonic, list it in docs/STATE.md instead of altering a value.
No UI string or test output mentions grams of fat.
